title: Document and verify the native Copilot Responses state contract: a direct synthetic upstream control shows store:true is rejected with HTTP 400 unsupported_value while store:false succeeds, so previous_response_id/stateful continuation cannot be promised. Compare ccexplore's stateless store:false plus full history/reasoning replay with VS Code customendpoint's default store:true and its zeroDataRetentionEnabled:true store:false mode. Add safe deterministic/probe evidence and operator guidance; distinguish upstream response storage from proxy/gateway accounting; make no speculative code change unless a reproducible proxy defect is found.
